outfits.name: Base (swimwear)
outfits.prompt: A petite young woman with golden-bronze skin and a curvy, soft figure stands a little over five feet tall. Her thick, glossy dark brown hair falls in loose waves past her shoulders, half-pulled into a tousled top knot that is already slipping loose, and her round, warm hazel-brown eyes beam with eager energy. A tiny star-shaped gold nose stud glints on her left nostril. She wears a coral-and-cream striped bikini with a ruched bralette top and high-waisted bottoms, over which hangs a loose, open-knit cream crochet cover-up dress falling to mid-thigh and left unfastened at the front. Stacks of thin gold anklets circle her right ankle above her bare feet. A pair of oversized tortoiseshell resin hoop earrings dangle from her earlobes. She stands with one hand planted firmly on her hip and the other caught mid-gesture in the air, fingers spread wide, her weight shifted casually onto one leg while the other foot lifts slightly off the ground. Her chin tilts up and her lips curve into a wide, ready grin that reaches her eyes. Full-body framing against a plain grey background. anime style, high quality, single character.

outfits.prompt: A petite young woman of Mexican-American heritage with golden-bronze skin and a curvy, soft figure. She wears a mustard-yellow cotton sundress printed with small white daisies, the thin spaghetti straps and square neckline sitting loose on her frame, the hem falling just above the knee with a slight ruffle. Over the dress, a cropped chunky-knit crochet cardigan in warm cream with oversized wooden buttons has its sleeves pushed up past her elbows. Brown leather strappy sandals with a low block heel sit on her feet. Chunky hexagonal resin earrings in swirls of orange and cream hang from her ears, a braided leather bracelet circles one wrist, and a thin crossbody bag strap crosses her chest. She stands with one hand on her hip and the other gesturing mid-air as if caught mid-sentence, weight shifted casually to one leg, head tilted slightly toward the raised hand.
